decisions.rationale: Effect-specific behavior definitions only, never a successful runtime stub, final state oracle, caller-authored receipt, candidate packet or ideal summary.

decisions.missing_spec_field: Actual core support distinct from authored fixture completeness
decisions.rationale: Read-only core inspection. Missing source/effect/turn mappings or unresolved dynamic preview inputs block execution before model access. Conditional/current revision enforcement cannot be supplied by declarations alone.
